atlanta/momocon.descripcion: An all-ages geek culture convention for fans of anime, American animation, comics, video games and tabletop games. It features cosplay, an exhibitors hall, and guests such as voice actors, artists, game developers and cosplayers.

atlanta/dragon-con.descripcion: A multi-media pop culture convention covering science fiction and fantasy, gaming, comics, literature, art, music and film. It includes guests and performers, gaming, contests, workshops, a parade, an art show, Artist Alley, vendors, author signings and photo ops.

denver/myths-legends-faire.descripcion: A creative event for dreamers, makers, artists and adventurers of all kinds and ages. It offers immersive cosplay, themed dressing and artisan vendors, and includes the Woodland Village with an Artist & Vendor Marketplace.

denver/colorado-anime-fest.descripcion: An anime convention with tabletop and video gaming, cosplay chess, AMV and costume contests, panels, a maid café, an exhibitors' hall and a manga library. It also has kids' programming, a quiet room, a cosplay cabaret, dance battles and a rave.

denver/fan-expo-denver.descripcion: A four-day pop culture convention for fans of comics, sci-fi, horror, anime, gaming and cosplay. It has celebrity, anime, voice, gaming and comic creator guests, plus photo ops, autograph sessions, a costume showcase, gaming booths and merchandise.

denver/milehicon.descripcion: A science fiction, fantasy and speculative fiction convention for fans of those genres. It lists author and artist guests of honor, a masquerade, ModelFest, an art show, authors row, a con suite, gaming, a vendors room and a literacy auction.

denver/b-con.descripcion: A small, family-oriented, semi-private tabletop games convention for gamers and fans. It offers open gaming, play-to-win games, a game library, oversized games, a used-game swap, a Spygame larp, a dealer room, a game design contest and guests of honor.

denver/colorado-renaissance-festival.descripcion: A Renaissance-themed festival set in a village called Larkspurshire. It has stage shows, kids' activities, themed weekends, a photo contest, food and drink, and artisan vendors selling items such as jewelry, leather goods, clothing and artwork.

denver/denver-central-games-weekly-magic.descripcion: A weekly schedule of Magic: The Gathering events at a game store. It includes casual Commander nights, plus Standard, Modern and Pauper sessions, with store-credit prize pools listed for the non-casual events.

denver/genghiscon.descripcion: A community tabletop gaming convention for newcomers and experienced players, with open tables for board games, card games and role-playing games. It has a public events schedule, attendee-hosted events, an exhibitor and sponsor section, and a vendor hall open to everyone.

denver/golden-game-guild-weekly-events.descripcion: Board game store, library and club with a large game library. Weekly events include Teach Me! Monday, One-Shot Wednesdays, Friday Night Magic drafts, and Magic: The Gathering Commander. It also runs Kids D&D and a Mah Jongg night.

denver/tacticon-colorado.descripcion: Tabletop gaming convention for new and veteran players, with board, miniatures, card and role-playing games. It has a miniatures gaming area with vendor booths, an adjacent Artists Alley for artists to show and sell work, and convention staff on hand throughout.

houston/animeverse-houston.descripcion: Anime fan event for all ages, with voice-actor panels and Q&A sessions, cosplay meetups, gaming tournaments, and a vendor hall with merchandise and original art. The page also invites artists, vendors, performers, panelists, cosplayers and content creators to apply.

los-angeles/anime-impulse-los-angeles.descripcion: Anime fan event with concerts, guest and voice actor panels, VTuber meet and greets, an Artist Alley and vendors, cosplay meetups, free arcade play, a gaming floor, and an Itasha display of decorated anime cars.

los-angeles/pasadena-comic-con.descripcion: A comic and toy convention with announced guests including cartoonist Patrick Owsley, Angry Beavers creator Mitch Schauer, and actors Richard Chaves and Karan Ashley. It has a vendor main hall, an Artist Alley, panels and a cosplay contest.

los-angeles/orccon.descripcion: A Strategicon convention where attendees can play, watch and buy board, card, miniatures, roleplaying, collectable and video games. It opens Friday at noon and runs until Monday at 6 p.m.

los-angeles/wondercon.descripcion: A convention run by the San Diego Comic Convention, with an exhibit hall of over 900 exhibitors, Artists' Alley and small press. Programming includes film and TV panels, comics professionals, autographs, games, portfolio reviews, a Masquerade, and a d4 Tabletop Creative Conference.

los-angeles/gamex.descripcion: A Strategicon convention where attendees can play, watch and buy board, card, miniatures, roleplaying, collectable and video games. It opens Friday at noon and runs until Monday at 6 p.m.

los-angeles/anime-expo.descripcion: An anime convention for anime and manga fans, cosplayers and industry professionals, run by the Society for the Promotion of Japanese Animation. It has panels, premieres, concerts, autograph sessions, a Masquerade, an exhibit hall, Artist Alley, and an arcade, console and tabletop gaming hall.

los-angeles/gateway.descripcion: A Southern California gaming convention that runs continuously over four days. It covers board, card, miniatures, roleplaying, collectable and video games, with a game library, event sign-ups, special guests, a dealer room, flea market, auction, painting contest, Family Area and a New to Gaming section.

los-angeles/hmgs-psw-mini-wars.descripcion: A tabletop gaming convention for gamers and enthusiasts across the Western United States. It has miniature battles in historical, fantasy, sci-fi and horror genres, plus board games, tournaments, painting competitions, a flea market and bring-n-buy, and a theme award tied to "Independence."

los-angeles/socal-gaming-expo.descripcion: A gaming convention open to anyone who loves gaming, regardless of age, race or nationality. It has a vendor marketplace, Tetris World Championships and esports tournaments, a free-play arcade, a gaming area and skate ramps, and guests including YouTubers and voice actors, along with cosplay.

santiago/ludifest.descripcion: Festival dedicado a los juegos de mesa y de cartas, con el lema «Juntémonos a Jugar». Está dirigido a la comunidad de jugadores y recibe postulaciones de editoriales, distribuidoras, tiendas y emprendedores que quieran participar como expositores o colaboradores.

santiago/alciffcon-iv.descripcion: Convención literaria organizada por la Asociación Chilena de Literatura de Ciencia Ficción y Fantasía, para quienes se interesan por la literatura especulativa, el cómic y la traducción. Incluye dos invitados de honor, paneles, el taller «Nostalgia» y la entrega de los premios Altísimo 2025.

santiago/comic-con-chile.descripcion: Convención de cultura pop y entretenimiento para seguidores del cine, la televisión, los videojuegos, los cómics, el cosplay y la ilustración. Ofrece paneles con invitados, Artist Alley, Cosplay Alley, Torneo Cosplay, Copa K-POP, shows musicales y una zona de fans.

santiago/expogame.descripcion: Evento presencial de videojuegos para público general. Tiene zonas de juego, en su mayoría free to play, stands de marcas, un mercado, shows en escenario, patio de comida y Pasaporte Expogame. También menciona invitados y un torneo llamado Expogame Champions.

santiago/trading-fest-chile.descripcion: Encuentro de juegos de cartas coleccionables enfocado en coleccionar, intercambiar, comprar, vender y competir en torneos. Está pensado para coleccionistas, comunidades de trading y jugadores competitivos, y reúne a más de 200 tiendas en un espacio de más de 3.000 metros cuadrados.

atlanta/georgia-renaissance-festival-fal.descripcion: A Renaissance-themed village that visitors explore, with Robin Hood and the Sheriff of Nottingham as the fall theme. It has live jousting, 15 live stages, 160+ artisan shoppes, food, games and rides. Aimed at families, couples, friends and cosplayers, with 21+ evening nights on select dates.

atlanta/anime-weekend-atlanta.descripcion: An anime convention for anime and gaming fans, featuring an Itasha vehicle display, a concert, a maid cafe, cosplay competitions, a manga library, and video and tabletop gaming. It also includes an Exhibit Hall with Artist Alley, a Starlight Idol Festival, a video art track, and a guest list.

atlanta/new-year-s-furry-festival.descripcion: An official event of Furry Weekend Atlanta for the furry community, open to ages 21+. It is described as a smaller, more intimate celebration with a large stage, live entertainment and dancing, run by a volunteer-led organization aiming for inclusive and safe experiences.

atlanta/atlanta-brick-con.descripcion: A LEGO fan convention for collectors, builders and families. It has hundreds of fan-built displays, hands-on Build Zones with thousands of bricks, costumed character meets, vendors selling sets and minifigures, and special guests including Master Builder Dan Steininger, LEGO Masters Mark and Steven Erickson, and magician Mike Edwards.

atlanta/dice-and-diversions.descripcion: A family-friendly tabletop gaming convention from the team behind the Southern-Fried Gaming Expo. It covers board games, role-playing games, miniatures and card games, and offers a weekend event schedule and a gaming library for attendees, plus a Game Master program and vendors.

atlanta/furry-weekend-atlanta.descripcion: A volunteer-led furry convention that describes itself as inclusive and safe, where attendees can express themselves. It lists hotel rates, a suite lottery, volunteer and staff options, and Lost-n-Found Youth as its charity partner, which supports young queer people in Atlanta.

atlanta/southern-fried-gaming-expo.descripcion: A gaming expo for arcade, pinball and tabletop fans, with over 400 arcade and pinball machines, console systems and a tabletop library. It also has tournaments (esports, Magic: The Gathering, pinball), a vendor expo, panels, VR, an indie game showcase, wrestling and music.

atlanta/georgia-renaissance-festival-fai.descripcion: A Renaissance-themed village south of Atlanta, aimed at families, first-time visitors and costumers. It has live jousting, 15 stages, over 160 artisan shoppes, food and drink, and games and rides. Select fall nights are 21+ After Dark events.

atlanta/halloween-trick-or-trot-run-5k-1.descripcion: An annual Halloween-themed run in Atlanta, offered at 5K, 10K and half-marathon (13.1) distances. Runners get free Halloween candy after the run. The organizers are separate from Atlanta Track Club, and registration goes through RunSignUp.

atlanta/magiccon-atlanta.descripcion: A Magic: The Gathering convention for players of all levels. It has over 100 ticketed play events grouped as social, challenging or competitive, plus a free Commander play area with judges, quick-play on-demand events and open play areas. Guests include Gavin Verhey.

chicago/prism-games-chicago-weekly-tcg-p.descripcion: Prism Games Chicago is an LGBTQ+ owned board game shop with a play space and a growing demo library. It hosts scheduled events, including Sunday Star Wars Unlimited and Riftbound play, Commander tournaments, and One Piece release and prerelease events.

chicago/agog-mensa-chicago-gaming-conven.descripcion: AGOG is a weekend gaming event run by Chicago Area Mensa and open to everyone, with no Mensa membership required. It has a 24-hour game room with hundreds of games, a few tournaments, teach-and-play sessions, RPG one-shots, and a megagame.

chicago/dupage-comic-con.descripcion: DuPage Comic Con is a family-friendly pop culture convention covering comics, anime, and gaming. It features comic artists, writers, and TV actors, plus dealers selling comics, toys, and trading card games. Activities include panels, artist alley, a cosplay contest, photo ops, and autographs.

chicago/polar-vortex.descripcion: Polar Vortex is a tabletop gaming convention for RPG, board game, and miniatures players. It offers tournaments such as CATAN and Star Wars Legion, a miniature painting competition, a costume contest, game demos, a board game library, vendors, a charity auction, and guest Keith Ammann.

chicago/adepticon.descripcion: AdeptiCon is a miniature wargaming convention covering the hobby and its wider community. It lists over 1,650 tournament and event games, over 275 hobby seminars, an exhibitor hall with more than 160 exhibitors, the Golden Demon painting competition, and a board game library.

chicago/c2e2-chicago-comic-entertainment.descripcion: A family-friendly pop culture convention covering comics, cosplay, gaming, authors, and anime. It features celebrity, comic creator, and author guests, photo ops and autographs, an Artist Alley, a Show Floor, and a talent show.

chicago/anime-central-acen.descripcion: An anime, manga, and Japanese pop culture convention for fans, with guests from the anime and manga industries and autograph sessions. It has a gaming hall with tournaments, arcade, PC, console, and tabletop play, plus an exhibit hall, Artist Alley, panels, concerts, and 24-hour video rooms.

chicago/chicago-steampunk-exposition.descripcion: A family-friendly festival of Steampunk and Victoriana for fans, with a theme of Victorian-era space travel. It offers entertainment, presentations, workshops, a Steam & Sorcery LARP game, an Underground Market, Artists' Alley & Printers' Row, and hallway exhibitors.

chicago/flashback-weekend-chicago-horror.descripcion: A horror convention marking its 25th anniversary, with celebrity guests including Matthew Lillard, plus dealer tables. Autographs and photos with celebrities happen only during scheduled official sessions, and a documentary is being filmed at the event.

chicago/anime-midwest.descripcion: A family-friendly anime convention focused on video gaming, anime, manga, and Japanese culture, for fans, cosplayers, and gamers. It includes voice actor guests, video game tournaments, the Cosplay World Crown, concerts on the Grand Stage, karaoke, a maid/butler cafe, and an exhibit hall.

chicago/bristol-renaissance-faire.descripcion: A Renaissance-themed fair where visitors can play along with the citizens of Bristol. It has a stage schedule that includes a joust, a marketplace with costumes and trinkets, food and drink, rides and games, and themed weekends.

chicago/fan-expo-chicago.descripcion: A three-day fan culture convention for fans of comics, sci-fi, horror, anime, gaming and cosplay, as well as families. It has celebrity guests, autograph and photo sessions, panels, a costume showcase, gaming booths, an Artist Alley and shopping.

chicago/haunted-halloween-half-marathon-.descripcion: A Halloween-themed half marathon and 5K for runners and walkers, many in costume. It has a costume contest with prize money, age group awards, finisher medals, a course through Lincoln Park and along the Lakefront Trail, and a post-race party.

chicago/barony-of-ayreton-sca-weekly-pra.descripcion: A Greater Chicagoland branch of the Society for Creative Anachronism, which recreates pre-17th-century cultures. It is open to the public and lists weekly fencing, fighting and crafting practices, a monthly business meeting, a crafting circle, a music group and a baronial moot.

chicago/protospiel-chicago.descripcion: A casual gathering where amateur and established game designers test prototype games and give each other feedback. Play testers and anyone who enjoys games can also attend. It runs over three days and includes open design time, a Chi-Bingo game, and free components from a sponsor.

chicago/social-game-night-snakes-lattes-.descripcion: A board game café, bar and restaurant with over 800 board games, a game vault, a full kitchen and bar, and themed private rooms. It hosts a weekly Social Game Night alongside trivia nights, tournaments, a puzzle race and a game designer night.

chicago/windycon.descripcion: A science fiction and fantasy convention run by Illinois Science Fiction in Chicago, for first-time and long-time fans. It lists guests of honor, programming, cosplay, gaming including RPGs and LARP, an art show and a vendor's hall.

houston/texas-renaissance-festival.descripcion: A renaissance-themed festival with sections for families, adults 21+ and first-time visitors. It offers an entertainment schedule with performers, themed weekends, guided tours, shops, food and drink, and camping and lodging options.

houston/retropalooza-houston.descripcion: An annual celebration of retro culture for families and for gamers and geeks of all generations. It features guests and creator panels, gaming tournaments, a cosplay contest, and vendors selling rare finds, collectibles and custom art.

houston/kimokawaii-anime-experience-conv.descripcion: An anime convention for fans, cosplayers, artists and vendors, with a year-round online community. Programming includes a cosplay contest, Japanese fashion show, voice acting sessions, panels and workshops, Anime Family Feud, a comedy show, photo ops, and an artist and vendor area.

houston/anime-matsuri.descripcion: An anime convention marking its 20th anniversary, with voice and cosplay guests. It features a cosplay contest, karaoke battle, fashion show, Wrestle Matsuri, Anime Academy workshops, LARP, and a rave, plus an Exhibit Hall with Artist Alley and video games, and an 18+ goods area.

houston/day-of-the-dead-half-marathon-ho.descripcion: A Día de los Muertos-themed race for runners and walkers, with a Kids Dash, 1 Mile Run, 5K, Quarter Marathon, Half Marathon and virtual option. It has a pre-race costume contest, mariachi bands at the start line, finisher medals and themed shirts.

houston/asgard-games-space-city-eternal-.descripcion: A Magic: The Gathering tournament in the Premodern format, hosted by Asgard Games, with a guaranteed cash prize pool that grows with attendance. Full proxy decks are allowed under stated rules, and door prizes are drawn during the event, with stamped cards for top participants.

houston/halcyon-games-nightly-events-pok.descripcion: A local game store north of Houston selling board games, trading card games, roleplaying games and Warhammer miniatures. Its play space for 32 players hosts events every night and on weekends, and a private room can be rented. It carries Pokémon, Magic, Lorcana and Flesh and Blood.

houston/the-forge-hobbies-games-7-nights.descripcion: A hobby game store for seasoned gamers and newcomers alike, running events across seven nights, including Warhammer tournaments, Magic: The Gathering release parties and TCG deck-building workshops. It has a play area with tables, terrain, a paint station and two RPG rooms.

los-angeles/collector-legion-weekly-even.descripcion: In-store weekly events at a collectibles shop, including a Pokémon League Challenge. The page shows the weekly schedule only as an image, so the other events and their formats are not stated.

los-angeles/renaissance-pleasure-faire-s.descripcion: A Renaissance-themed fair with a stage schedule, a joust, a bird of prey show and magic shows. Visitors can try archery and spear throwing, browse artisan booths, and attend theme weekends, a Pub Crawl, Queen's College and Tea With the Queen.

los-angeles/meeples-family-board-game-ca.descripcion: A board game café with a library of roughly 2,000 games that is still growing. It suits party game players, card game fans, Euro-style strategy gamers and explorers, and offers private tables seating up to six people, booked in one-hour blocks.

new-york/big-apple-comic-con-holiday-con.descripcion: A comic convention billed as "It's Not Just Comics," here in its holiday edition. The page lists an exhibitors directory, an Artist Alley and Balcony area, and a non-sports card marketplace and gaming event, but gives no further detail on guests or activities.

new-york/festival-of-games.descripcion: A two-day holiday shopping and gaming event presented by Cradle-Con and the Long Island Retro Gaming Expo. It features local small businesses selling retro games, toys, comics and collectibles, unlimited play on over 60 arcade classics, retro consoles, workshops, and table-top and board games.

new-york/new-jersey-renaissance-faire.descripcion: A costumed, interactive Renaissance-themed faire set in the "Shire of New Crossford," aimed at families, couples and dog owners. It has daytime shows, a cast and storyline, an Artisan Village with over 30 merchants, kids' activities, tastings, and ticketed Saturday night After Hours shows.

new-york/new-york-renaissance-faire.descripcion: A Renaissance-themed festival for families, friends and fantasy fans, held on wooded former botanical garden grounds. It offers scheduled shows, a joust, parades, artisan shops, food and mead, ax and knife throwing, archery, and children's games. Costumes are optional.

new-york/new-york-comic-con.descripcion: A pop culture convention for fans of comics, anime, gaming, fantasy, sci-fi and horror, including cosplayers and families. It features a show floor, Artist Alley, Cosplay Central with the Crown Championships of Cosplay, live stage content, celebrity and creator guests, autographs and photo ops.

new-york/dexlite.descripcion: A tabletop gaming convention with hundreds of board and card games, role-playing and LARP events, wargames and miniatures. It also has national championship qualifiers for Spades, Hearts, Euchre and Doomlings, game libraries, game shows and a dealers' room.

new-york/gladiators-nyc-medieval-festiva.descripcion: A community-focused medieval festival for audiences of all ages, presented by Gladiators NYC. Visitors can watch live armored demonstrations and exhibition bouts, join interactive activities, and get close to armored combat fighters.

new-york/haunted-jersey-city-5k.descripcion: A Halloween-themed run and walk where participants are encouraged to wear costumes. It offers a 5K and a 1 Mile Fun Run on two haunted courses, with chip timing, age-group awards, music, entertainment and race photos with the Manhattan skyline.

new-york/nyc-area-friends-of-jrr-tolkien.descripcion: A New York Meetup group for fantasy fans interested in Tolkien, C.S. Lewis, the Inklings and related works. It hosts in-person and online meetups and discussions of The Lord of the Rings, The Hobbit, Narnia and A Song of Ice and Fire.

new-york/urban-wizards-social-club.descripcion: A New York Meetup group run as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit for wizarding, fantasy and magical fans of any identity. Activities include trivia nights, board game nights, movie screenings, cosplay photoshoots, convention appearances and in-costume ice skating.

san-diego/scg-con-san-diego.descripcion: A trading card game convention stop for TCG enthusiasts, with Magic: The Gathering and Riftbound named. It lists competitive tournaments, side events, special guests, vendors and artists, and chances to play and trade. San Diego-specific details are still to be announced.

san-diego/the-kook-run.descripcion: A coastal road race in Encinitas with 10K and 5K distances, plus a virtual option and a kids' dash for ages 3-12. The out-and-back course follows Coast Highway 101 with ocean views, and participants can enter a costume contest.

san-diego/fangaea.descripcion: A pop culture and fandom convention covering comics, tabletop and video games, steampunk, cosplay and technology. It has panels, a cosplay contest, featured artists, vendors, special guests and dedicated tabletop and video game sections.

san-diego/comic-con-international-san-di.descripcion: A convention run by a nonprofit that promotes awareness of comics and related popular arts. It offers programs, autographs, anime, film, games, a masquerade, an Exhibit Hall with Artists' Alley, and cosplay, for attendees, professionals, exhibitors and press.

san-diego/san-diego-anime-con.descripcion: An anime convention produced by Silk Road Productions. The program includes general panels on anime-related topics, a Dynamic Room with interactive hands-on sessions, and a maid cafe with games. It also lists a game room, cosplay meetups and a cosplay contest.

bogota/ludolab-sala-labco-biblored.descripcion: Laboratorio de cocreación de BibloRed para explorar y adaptar juegos de mesa, de modo que sean más accesibles, sobre todo para personas con discapacidad visual y auditiva. Está abierto a personas con y sin discapacidad, y las sesiones incluyen interpretación en Lengua de Señas Colombiana.
